# PipMCP and LeadAdapter task directory

> Source-backed API integration and agent workflow discovery. This static directory does not accept credentials or execute providers.

## Discover by task

- [Machine-readable task catalog](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks.json): inputs, access, exact operation IDs, actual public repositories and evidence boundaries.
- [Task index](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/)
- [LeadAdapter solutions](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/solutions/leadadapter/): one LeadAdapter workspace API key, SDK0.2 research workflow, remote MCP0.3 bridge and agent skills.

## Important execution boundaries

LeadAdapter SDKs call its REST API. The current MCP bridge discovers remote tools at https://leadadapter.com/mcp and forwards approved calls; it is not the historical fixed five-tool local implementation. Tool discovery is not LinkedIn provider execution. Use the matching repository version and inspect real remote tool availability. Native CRM promotion requires explicit approval; external CRM needs a named provider and separate approval. Preserve full URNs; never infer prospect identity from names.

Current PipMCP gateway clients require PIPMCP_API_KEY. Provider credentials and execution profiles remain hosted; tools are discovered dynamically. Historical local-provider proof is labeled separately and does not prove current managed execution.

## Tasks

- [Research LinkedIn people and promote reviewed prospects to CRM](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/research-to-crm/): Run focused people research, wait for completed results, match exact stored prospect identities, then explicitly approve native LeadAdapter CRM promotion. External CRM sync requires a named provider and separate approval.
- [Find relevant LinkedIn people](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/linkedin-people-research/): Search people using explicit keywords, follow the returned job receipt and inspect completed results before using them in another workflow.
- [Enrich a selected LinkedIn profile](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/linkedin-profile-enrichment/): Request available profile context for a known LinkedIn URN, public profile ID or captured lead. Preserve source identity and inspect actual coverage.
- [Research the people engaging with a LinkedIn post](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/linkedin-post-audience/): Request post-engager information available to the connected account, then review exact identities before qualifying prospects.
- [Read and export captured leads](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/leadadapter-lead-export/): Read workspace-scoped leads, apply documented filters and paginate the API export into your own destination mapping.
- [Connect a LinkedIn publishing calendar](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/leadadapter-content-calendar/): Read existing content and scheduled post states, then use documented write operations when an approved publishing workflow is needed.
- [Review proposed LinkedIn sales actions](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/leadadapter-approved-actions/): Read pending approvals and action audit records, then decide specific proposals through the documented governance workflow.
- [React to lead, comment and approval events](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/leadadapter-event-driven-sales/): Inspect configured webhook subscriptions and delivery history, then configure an authorized signed-event receiver using the API reference.
- [Import an OpenAPI API into private PipMCP](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/openapi-to-mcp/): Preview and explicitly upload a reviewed API definition with one PipMCP key. Review and publish selected tools in the workspace, configure a connection and use explicit custom-api integration selection.
- [Import a Swagger2 API into private PipMCP](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/swagger-to-mcp/): Preview and explicitly upload a reviewed API definition with one PipMCP key. Review and publish selected tools in the workspace, configure a connection and use explicit custom-api integration selection.
- [Import a reviewed Postman collection into MCP tools](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/postman-to-mcp/): Preview and explicitly upload a reviewed API definition with one PipMCP key. Review and publish selected tools in the workspace, configure a connection and use explicit custom-api integration selection.
- [Import a GraphQL schema into private PipMCP](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/graphql-to-mcp/): Preview and explicitly upload a reviewed API definition with one PipMCP key. Review and publish selected tools in the workspace, configure a connection and use explicit custom-api integration selection.
- [Repository issue briefing](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/github-workflow/): Identify your account, then list a chosen repository’s issues for a daily triage brief.
- [hubspot-workflow](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/hubspot-workflow/): Find CRM contacts and inspect their properties before creating a new contact in the same HubSpot account.
- [Shared document discovery](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/google-drive-workflow/): Search available file metadata and inspect a chosen document before requesting its contents.
- [Issue status brief](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/linear-workflow/): Confirm the API key owner and collect a page of issues to summarize project activity.
- [Channel access audit](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/slack-workflow/): Identify the connected workspace and list visible conversations before choosing a notification channel.
- [CRM table briefing](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/airtable-workflow/): Find an accessible base and read one selected table to prepare a customer briefing.
- [Knowledge search](https://jannikco.github.io/pipmcp-connectors/tasks/notion-workflow/): Verify the connected integration, then search shared notes by title for a meeting briefing.
